description: Real tender requirements: the 39 requirement lines that the n8n pipeline sent to the RAG in its third live run (RAG v2, 2026-10-20), 9 tenders in Company and Demo mode. Requests are copied as sent (node 'Join Buyers & Build RAG', items[].rag_body). Expected statuses and proof documents were written from the documents themselves (CV PDFs through the loader, JSON records of data/), before the RAG answers of that run were opened. Demo records count only in Demo mode; Demo mode searches the CVs and the demo records, Company mode the CVs and the company records.
policy: covered: a document of the mode's knowledge base clearly proves the line as written, with the requested count.
partial: related evidence only, a count that is not reached, or an equivalent certification instead of the one named (CSM for PSM).
missing: no document proves it; award criteria and administrative documents (financial capacity, 'quality of the organisation must be demonstrated') are not capabilities a CV or record can prove.
A certification is proved only by a holder; compliance work or a stack description is not a certificate.
Experience lines count completed projects with a recorded sector; ongoing projects and client relationships are not deliveries.
Senior means 5+ years of professional experience in the role.
proof: documents that prove the line (2 = clear proof, 1 = passing or related proof). Keys are full record IDs or CV prefixes (CV_NN).
terms: words a quoted proof line must hold (prefix match on whole words); a quote with none of them, or shorter than 4 words, is a fragment.
